page.overview:
What is Unidentified insurgent group?

An insurgent group operated on Genya. Members of the group were once enslaved by the Zonus Corporation, but escaped and sought to free members of their families who remained enslaved. The company's CEO, Jin-Sim Canbelon, hired the bounty hunters Sevn and IV-A4 to capture the insurgents, claiming they had attacked one of the company's mines. After learning the truth, Sevn helped the insurgents free their families.

The insurgent group appeared in "The Bounty Hunters," an animated short film produced by WIT Studio as part of the third volume of the non-canon Star Wars: Visions series, released on Disney+
